name: The Prologue to a Dream of Home
source: One hundred years before the events of A Dream of Home, Dr. Seth Schumann's reality simulation is nearly complete. With the birth of the Narcissus Project, Eridean scientists have discovered a means to project the soul as art. Who will finish Schumann's unfinished masterpiece?
translation: 在《A Dream of Home》的故事发生一百年前，塞思·舒曼博士的现实模拟系统已接近完成。随着“水仙计划”的诞生，Eridean科学家找到了一种将灵魂投射为艺术的方式。谁将完成舒曼尚未完成的杰作？
